faq.q: Is this for a library or an application?
faq.a: It's a minimal PHP project structure suitable for both. Add your entry point (public/index.php for web, bin/console for CLI) after generation.

faq.q: Does it include a framework (Symfony, Laravel)?
faq.a: No — this is a plain PHP template. Use the `laravel` template for Laravel, or add Symfony components after generation.
PSR-4 autoloading is configured in composer.json (src/ -> App\\). Run `composer dump-autoload` after adding classes.
